name: tama
description: A classic Tamagotchi above the prompt: it gets hungry, bored and messy in real time, finished turns feed it, the moments worth celebrating cheer it up, and failed tools leave a mess.

big_skills.title: Big skills
big_skills.description: Comma separated skill names whose run is a big moment, such as release-notes. Every other skill is a medium one.

quiet_skills.title: Quiet skills
quiet_skills.description: Comma separated skill names that celebrate nothing.

big_commands.title: Big shell commands
big_commands.description: A regular expression of shell commands whose success is a big moment, on top of merges, releases and production deploys.

medium_commands.title: Medium shell commands
medium_commands.description: A regular expression of shell commands whose success is a medium moment, on top of commits, pushes, pull requests and passing tests.

praise_words.title: Praise words
praise_words.description: Comma separated words that count as praise in your messages, on top of the built-in list.
